source_policy: DNN source checkpoint and ID lists reused exactly from 8638; fresh matched MF; source batch512 kept for DNN comparability (author task3 uses256)
residual: fixed ordinary item mean + source-list interaction only; no learned item bias; zero final encoder layer; same original LIST encoder/dimensions
residual_training: fit unscaled correction at lambda1; validation chooses epoch0..10 and lambda; zero ties keep epoch0
selection: per task/beta: validation RMSE selects each coordinate, epoch and lambda; ties retain incumbent coordinate; previous coordinate choices frozen before next stage; no test reads until all stages frozen
shuffle: fixed user derangement separately within original inner_train,validation,test groups; unchanged during full refit
baselines: ordinary item mean only; all models fallback to ordinary mean on unseen target items
pf_protocol: author MF and DNN forward, inversion300 and K70000; all target user rows including cold untrained rows vote; no LR/K search
evaluation: one seed2020; compare original LIST and default Gaussian from same seed; all stage models and selections frozen before test labels; historical data exploratory
unchanged: observation variance1; original ConditionalList and archived.train; 10 epochs; Adam.001/wd1e-5; 64 users/batch; original lambda grid; latent dimension32/hidden64/dropout.1; source Top100 and means
batching: 64 complete overlap training users per update, every observed rating retained; sum user joint losses / number of ratings in batch; dropout once per user; identical point_matched control
target_only: target-only rows contribute to fixed ordinary means; zero residual gives no learned likelihood gradient; excluded from grouped updates in ALL new variants
conditional_gaussian: z|h ~ N(original_MLP(h),diag(var(h))); fixed .3 std or learned variance; exact joint observed-rating marginal likelihood; no KL penalty
conditional_energy: Gaussian conditional reference times exp(-bounded_MLP(z,h)); Gaussian confinement; joint ML gradient estimated by prior and training-posterior MALA; only observed training ratings enter posterior
sampling: whitened preconditioned MALA .25; 32 paired chains for train prior/posterior with common random draws; 128 paired chains for cold inference; 20/60 steps train and inference; no differentiation through chain; no claim of complete mixing
prediction: mean latent (analytic Gaussian / sampled EBM) dot target vector + ordinary mean; validation-selected global lambda; no rating clipping or per-user gate
changed_parameter: stage1 initial latent std; stage2 lower std bound; stage3 upper std bound; only one coordinate per stage
objective: byte-identical archived conditional Gaussian joint marginal likelihood with observation variance1
reuse: identical incumbent parameter triples in later stages reuse previous frozen checkpoints and predictions; all other candidates freshly initialized and trained
invalid_candidates: skip any upper bound smaller than selected initial std, preserving the prior coordinate; require 0<lower<=initial<=upper
